feature: Recursive external JVM table-function ARRAY/List conversions

configuration.runtime: Complete Flink SQL jobs; elapsed submission through completion after symmetric EXPLAIN
configuration.source: Row source generates fresh payloads cycling through 48 logical shapes; blackhole row sink
configuration.perimeter: Both RowData-to-Arrow and Arrow-to-RowData transposes retained, plus released conversions, production JNI and owned output writes
configuration.order: Alternating engine order within each pair; separate serial JVM for each case/revision/Flink line
configuration.callback: Two mutable-output emissions per non-null input; matching argument/result types return the argument, result-only custom Lists are constructed recursively
configuration.route: Candidate requires positive consumed work from NativeTableFunction and both transposes; preceding production requires zero substitutions and no native work

interpretation: UDF coverage under the accepted performance exception. Includes startup/JIT, intrinsic conversions and all measured end-to-end costs. Separate-JVM stock drift is retained. No acceleration claim or causal profiling attribution.

additional_alias_verification.description: Final scalar fast-path plus eight retained-alias producer/consumer controls, on both released Flink lines; one added direct-binary case and eight repeated controls.

earlier_baseline_diagnostic.reason: Earlier comparison used canonical ca4b8bee and its qualified native library. Final comparison was repeated after integration onto canonical 2bb52ca2 and a fresh release build. Earlier trials are retained as diagnostics, excluded from the final table.
